answer: Because the timing is written down against the terrace challenge, the wharf audit can replay the harbor history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 254 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 87 aliases cost 68 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
